They're signed out at once and can't sign in. A task from a pool goes back to it, unless someone else is still on it. Their other tasks go to their acting user if they have one; otherwise a task nobody else is on is left unassigned for you to reassign.

You can reactivate them later, and they come back with the roles they have now.
